The '''C3-DD NeuroNet brain''' was a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]]. It was a functional unit but lacked the capability for abstract through or higher reasoning. [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] [[AR-2B Utility Droid]]s were equipped with C3-DD NeuroNet brains.
